quotes.label: definition
quotes.quote: The X-Robots-Tag response header defines how crawlers should index URLs.

quotes.label: de-facto
quotes.quote: While not part of any specification, it is a de-facto standard method for communicating with search bots, web crawlers, and similar user agents.

quotes.label: non-html-role
quotes.quote: Specifying indexing rules in an HTTP header is useful for non-HTML documents like images, PDFs, or other media.

quotes.label: bot-scope
quotes.quote: An optional <bot-name>: specifies the user agent that the subsequent rules should apply to

quotes.label: multi-field
quotes.quote: The following response has two X-Robots-Tag headers, each with an indexing rule specified

quotes.label: single-field-same
quotes.quote: In the response below, the same indexing rules are defined, but in a single header.

quotes.label: rule-behind-agent
quotes.quote: Each indexing rule applies to the user agent specified behind it

quotes.label: sum-negative
quotes.quote: For situations where multiple crawlers are specified along with different rules, the search engine will use the sum of the negative rules.

quotes.label: googlebot-composition
quotes.quote: The page containing these headers will be interpreted as having a noindex, nofollow rule when crawled by googlebot

quotes.label: conflict-fragment
quotes.quote: the more restrictive rule applies.

quotes.label: conflict-example
quotes.quote: For example, if a page has both max-snippet:50 and nosnippet rules, the nosnippet rule will apply.

quotes.label: mutually-exclusive
quotes.quote: Some values are mutually exclusive

quotes.label: mutually-exclusive-pair
quotes.quote: such as index and noindex

quotes.label: undefined-behaviour
quotes.quote: In these cases, the crawler's behavior is undefined and may vary.

quotes.label: all-default
quotes.quote: This rule is the default value and has no effect if explicitly listed.

quotes.label: none-expansion
quotes.quote: Equivalent to noindex, nofollow

quotes.label: noindex
quotes.quote: Do not show this page, media, or resource in search results.

quotes.label: nofollow
quotes.quote: Do not follow the links on this page.

quotes.label: nosnippet
quotes.quote: Do not show a text snippet or video preview in the search results for this page.

quotes.label: noimageindex
quotes.quote: Do not index images on this page.

quotes.label: notranslate
quotes.quote: Don't offer translation of this page in search results.

quotes.label: indexifembedded-effect
quotes.quote: indexifembedded only has an effect if it's accompanied by noindex

quotes.label: max-snippet-invalid
quotes.quote: Ignored if no valid <number> is specified.

quotes.label: max-image-preview-values
quotes.quote: specify a max-image-preview value of standard or none

quotes.label: max-image-preview-large
quotes.quote: A larger image preview, up to the width of the viewport, may be shown.

quotes.label: max-video-zero
quotes.quote: At most, a static image may be used, in accordance to the max-image-preview setting.

quotes.label: max-video-unlimited
quotes.quote: No video length limit.

quotes.label: date-families
quotes.quote: A date must be specified in a format such as RFC 822

quotes.label: date-invalid
quotes.quote: Ignored if no valid <date/time> is specified.

quotes.label: crawl-rate
quotes.quote: Crawlers are expected to considerably decrease the crawl rate of the URL after the specified date and time.

quotes.label: cooperative-only
quotes.quote: Only cooperative robots follow these rules

quotes.label: must-fetch
quotes.quote: a crawler first needs to access the resource to read headers and meta elements

quotes.label: robots-blocked
quotes.quote: Indexing rules won't be discovered or applied if paths are blocked from being crawled by a robots.txt file.

quotes.label: revisit
quotes.quote: a robot must first revisit the page to detect the X-Robots-Tag rule.

quotes.label: no-specification
quotes.quote: Not part of any current specification.

quotes.label: agent-optional
quotes.quote: It's possible to specify which user agent the rules should apply to.

quotes.label: s449-global-unprefixed
quotes.quote: Rules specified without a user agent are valid for all crawlers.

quotes.label: s449-case-insensitive
quotes.quote: The HTTP header, the user agent name, and the specified values are not case sensitive.

quotes.label: s449-conflict
quotes.quote: In the case of conflicting robots rules, the more restrictive rule applies.

quotes.label: s449-multi-field
quotes.quote: Multiple X-Robots-Tag headers can be combined within the HTTP response, or you can specify a comma-separated list of rules.

quotes.label: s449-prefix-before
quotes.quote: The X-Robots-Tag may optionally specify a user agent before the rules.

quotes.label: s449-same-vocabulary
quotes.quote: Any rule that can be used in a robots meta tag can also be specified as an X-Robots-Tag.

quotes.label: s449-historical
quotes.quote: The following rules aren't used by Google Search and are ignored.

quotes.label: s449-noarchive
quotes.quote: The noarchive rule is no longer used by Google Search

quotes.label: s449-date-families
quotes.quote: must be specified in a widely adopted format including, but not limited to RFC 822, RFC 850, and ISO 8601

quotes.label: s449-pst-example
quotes.quote: X-Robots-Tag: unavailable_after: 25 Jun 2010 15:00:00 PST

quotes.label: s449-sum-negative
quotes.quote: the search engine will use the sum of the negative rules.
